newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman stock index drops in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman stock index drops in moderate trade.

text.p: Oman's bourse witnessed moderate trade in the week to Wednesday with demand focusing on banking and investment stocks, a market report said.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index dropped to 270.19 points from last week's 277.19 points.
The value of the week's trade fell to 18.6 million rials from 30.2 million rials in the previous close.
Some 6.3 million shares changed hands, down from 10.5 a week earlier.
Of the 67 companies traded, 26 rose, 34 fell and seven were steady.
Shares of Al-Ahlia Portfolio Company, a leading player in the week, closed at 7.850 rials from last week's 7.800.
Commercial Bank of Oman shares made gains closing at 2.570 rials compared to 2.440 last week.
Banking and investment sectors accounted for 73 percent of the week's total trade value. -- Dubai newsroom 9714-607-1222
